errors.evidence: The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the effect on different language families with bars grouped by category and sub-bars indicating different models or configurations.
The description omits the y-axis label ('effect'), its linear scale, and the value range (0 to 40) with tick intervals of 5 units.
The description does not mention the x-axis categories (language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic).
The description fails to mention the six distinct bars per category representing models (mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂) and their corresponding colors.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are grouped, not stacked.
The description omits the presence of a legend in the top right corner.
The description does not provide approximate values for key groups (e.g., IE-Indic ranges from 17 to 23, Uralic mostly below 5, Semitic from -8 to 20).
The description does not mention that the Uralic family has the shortest bars (around 1–2).
The description does not state that the chart does not visually emphasize specific bars through shading or annotation.
The description does not explicitly mention that groups within a category are visually separated for model-wise comparison.
The description does not highlight that the Semitic group has larger error bars compared to other groups.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the effect to 'TARG and PERMUTE,' which are not mentioned in the figure or atom checklist. The figure shows effects for different models (e.g., mBERT, XLM) and configurations.
